title: NFC Championship, the Linc's loudest night
story: The Eagles routed the Vikings 38–7 with Nick Foles at quarterback and punched their ticket to Super Bowl LII.

title: Super Bowl LII, Foles and the Philly Special
story: A backup quarterback caught a touchdown on fourth down and the Eagles beat the Patriots 41–33 for their first Super Bowl.

title: DeVonta Smith's first touchdown
story: The rookie caught his first NFL touchdown in a 32–6 opening-day win in Atlanta.

title: NFC Championship
story: The Eagles beat the 49ers 31–7 at the Linc to reach Super Bowl LVII.

title: Super Bowl LVII
story: A 38–35 shootout the Chiefs won with a field goal in the last seconds. A loss, and still one of the great Super Bowls.

title: Saquon Barkley's 2,000-yard game
story: Barkley became the ninth player to rush for 2,000 yards in a season, in a 41–7 win over Dallas.

title: NFC Championship
story: The Eagles put 55 points on the Commanders to reach Super Bowl LIX.

title: Super Bowl LIX
story: The Eagles led 24–0 at the half and beat the Chiefs 40–22 for their second Super Bowl.

title: Bryce Harper's Phillies debut
story: Opening Day at Citizens Bank Park, and the Phillies beat the Braves 10–4 in Harper's first game in red pinstripes.

title: NLDS Game 3, the Hoskins bat spike
story: Rhys Hoskins homered and spiked his bat in the first postseason game at Citizens Bank Park in eleven years, a 9–1 win.

title: NLCS Game 5, the swing of his life
story: Bryce Harper's go-ahead home run in the rain sent the Phillies to the World Series.

title: Five home runs at Citizens Bank Park
story: The Phillies tied a World Series record with five home runs in Game 3.

title: Cubs win Game 7, 108 years
story: Ten innings and a rain delay later, the Cubs beat Cleveland 8–7 for their first title since 1908.

title: Super Bowl LI, back from 28–3
story: The Patriots came back from 25 points down to beat the Falcons 34–28 in the first Super Bowl overtime.

title: The Minneapolis Miracle
story: Stefon Diggs caught a pass with ten seconds left and ran it in as time expired, 29–24.

title: The Field of Dreams game
story: The first major league game in Iowa, next to the movie set, ended on a walk-off home run from Tim Anderson, 9–8.

title: Thirteen seconds
story: The Chiefs tied it in the last thirteen seconds and won in overtime, 42–36, after 25 points in the final two minutes.

title: Aaron Judge's 62nd home run
story: Judge passed Roger Maris for the American League record on the second-to-last day of the season.

title: Tom Brady's last game
story: A wild-card loss to Dallas, the last game of a 23-season career.

title: Ohtani's 50/50 game
story: Shohei Ohtani hit three home runs and stole two bases to become the first player with 50 of each in a season.

title: Freddie Freeman's walk-off grand slam
story: The first walk-off grand slam in World Series history won Game 1 in the tenth inning.
